response.original_title: WAGNER, R.: Colon Ring (The) - Der Ring des Nibelungen in 7 Hours (Teatro Colon, 2012)
response.overview: For the 200th birthday of Richard Wagner, C Major releases Der Ring des Nibelungen from Teatro Colon, Buenos Aires in an edited version which is authorized by the Wagner family. Conductor and pianist, Cord Garben shorted the 16 hour Ring to seven hours, without abandoning important elements. The box includes the documentary the Colon Ring - Wagner in Buenos Aires. COLON RING: DER RING DES NIBELUNGEN IN 7 HOURS Music & Performance C Major
